To: All Staff
From: Finance Department
Subject: Updated Business Travel Policy

Effective November 1st, we are updating our business travel reimbursement policy. Employees traveling for business purposes should note the following changes:

- Daily meal allowance increases from $40 to $55
- Hotel bookings must now be made through our approved travel portal to qualify for reimbursement
- Receipts for expenses over $25 must be submitted within 14 days of returning from the trip (previously 30 days)

These changes are intended to simplify the reimbursement process while ensuring better tracking of travel expenses. Employees with trips already booked before November 1st will be reimbursed under the previous policy.

Please direct any questions to the Finance Department.

PRODUCT RECALL NOTICE

Product: HomeSafe Model X200 Space Heater
Issued by: HomeSafe Appliances

HomeSafe Appliances is voluntarily recalling the Model X200 Space Heater due to a potential wiring defect that could pose a fire hazard under certain conditions. This recall affects units sold between January and June of this year with serial numbers starting with "X200-A."

Customers who own an affected unit should stop using it immediately and contact HomeSafe customer support to arrange a free repair or a full refund. Do not attempt to repair the unit yourself.

To check whether your unit is affected, locate the serial number on the bottom of the device and visit our website's recall lookup tool, or call our recall hotline at 1-800-555-0142.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your prompt attention to this important safety notice.

Introducing the SoundWave Pro Wireless Earbuds

Experience premium sound quality with the SoundWave Pro. These earbuds feature active noise cancellation, up to 8 hours of battery life on a single charge, and an additional 24 hours from the charging case.

Other features include water resistance (IPX4 rating), touch controls for music and calls, and a companion app for customizing sound settings.

The SoundWave Pro is available for $129.99 and comes with a one-year limited warranty. Order by December 15th to guarantee delivery before the holidays.

Read what our customers are saying below.
passage2:
★★★☆☆ (3 out of 5 stars)
Reviewed by: musiclover82

I ordered these earbuds mainly for the noise cancellation feature, and I have to say it works really well on flights and in noisy offices. The sound quality is also quite good for the price.

However, I was disappointed that the battery life did not quite match the advertised 8 hours; in my experience, it's closer to 6 hours with noise cancellation turned on. The companion app is also a bit limited compared to competitors, offering only basic equalizer settings.

Overall, these are decent earbuds for the price, but I would manage my expectations regarding battery life if noise cancellation is important to you.
